final: WITH c AS (SELECT cu.customer_id, cu.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS num_orders FROM Customers cu LEFT JOIN Orders o ON o.customer_id = cu.customer_id WHERE cu.gender IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(cu.gender) <> '' GROUP BY cu.customer_id, cu.gender), s AS (SELECT customer_id, gender, num_orders, CAST(num_orders AS REAL) / NULLIF(SUM(num_orders) OVER (PARTITION BY gender), 0) AS share FROM c), a AS (SELECT s.*, AVG(share) OVER () AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT customer_id, gender, num_orders, share, share - avg_share AS gap_above_average FROM a WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY gap_above_average DESC LIMIT 10
